title: Meet the project team
grammar: Present Simple — falar do trabalho dos outros (he works / she is responsible for)
objective: Nesta aula você vai apresentar o time de projeto em inglês, que é a primeira coisa que acontece numa reunião de abertura com o cliente. Você vai usar o Present Simple na terceira pessoa (he works, she manages, it takes) e a estrutura 'to be responsible for'. Atenção ao -s do he/she/it: é o detalhe que mais chama atenção quando falta.
intro: In the kick-off meeting, the first thing we do is present the team. Who is here? What does each person do? Who do you call when you have a problem?

This is simple English, but it must be correct. He works in the mechanical discipline. She is responsible for the electrical package. I am the focal point for the client. Today we practise these three patterns.
vocab: The kick-off meeting starts at nine o'clock.
Our project team has eight engineers.
Each person has a clear role in the project.
My responsibility is the detailed design.
Fernando is the focal point for the piping discipline.
The designers report to the discipline leader.
practice: Each person has a clear ______ in the project.
Fernando is the ______ for the piping discipline.
In the ______ we present the team to the client.
Who is the ______ for the electrical package?

audio.title: Presenting the team to the client
audio.text: Good morning everyone. Welcome to the kick off meeting. Let me present our project team. My name is Fernando and I work in detail engineering. I am the focal point for the client. This is Carlos. He is the project manager and he reports to the engineering director. Ana is here too. She is responsible for the electrical package and she works with two designers. Marcelo takes care of the piping discipline. He has fifteen years of experience. Every discipline has one focal point. If you have a question, you talk to the focal point first. Thank you.

readAloud: My name is Fernando and I work in detail engineering.
He is the project manager.
She is responsible for the electrical package.
Marcelo takes care of the piping discipline.
Every discipline has one focal point.
fill: She ___ responsible for the electrical package. (be)
Marcelo ___ care of the piping discipline. (take)
The designers ___ to the discipline leader. (report)
We ___ eight engineers in the team. (have)
qa: What do you do?
I work in detail engineering.
Who is the project manager?
Carlos is the project manager.
What is Ana responsible for?
She is responsible for the electrical package.
Who do the designers report to?
They report to the discipline leader.
How many people are there in the team?
There are eight engineers in the team.
sentences: My name is Fernando and I work in detail engineering.
He is the project manager.
She is responsible for the electrical package.
I am the focal point for the client.
Marcelo takes care of the piping discipline.
Every discipline has one focal point.
The designers report to the discipline leader.
Welcome to the kick-off meeting.
grammarPoint:
Present Simple = a rotina e a função de cada um.

I / you / we / they → verbo normal: I work in engineering. · They report to the leader.
He / she / it → verbo + s: He works in engineering. · She manages the team.

O verbo to be: I am · he/she/it is · you/we/they are.

A estrutura da função: to be responsible for + coisa → She is responsible for the electrical package.
deepDive:
O -s do he/she/it tem três formas:
• regra geral: work → works, report → reports
• termina em -o, -s, -sh, -ch, -x: go → goes, watch → watches
• termina em consoante + y: study → studies, carry → carries

Dois verbos irregulares que você usa todo dia: have → has · do → does.
Every discipline has one focal point.

Como falar da função — três formas iguais em sentido:
She is responsible for the electrical package.
She is in charge of the electrical package.
She takes care of the electrical package.

Cuidado: depois de responsible for, in charge of e take care of, o verbo vem com -ing: She is responsible for checking the drawings.
examples: I work in detail engineering.
Eu trabalho na engenharia de detalhamento.
He works in the mechanical discipline.
Ele trabalha na disciplina mecânica.
She is responsible for the electrical package.
Ela é responsável pelo pacote elétrico.
Marcelo takes care of the piping discipline.
O Marcelo cuida da disciplina de tubulação.
Every discipline has one focal point.
Cada disciplina tem um ponto focal.
The designers report to the discipline leader.
Os projetistas se reportam ao líder de disciplina.
I am the focal point for the client.
Eu sou o ponto focal para o cliente.
She is in charge of checking the drawings.
Ela é responsável por conferir os desenhos.
mistakes: He work in the mechanical discipline.
He works in the mechanical discipline.
Com he/she/it o verbo leva -s.
She is responsible of the package.
She is responsible for the package.
responsible sempre vem com for.
Every discipline have one focal point.
Every discipline has one focal point.
Every + singular pede has.
I am work in detail engineering.
I work in detail engineering.
Não use am junto com o verbo no Present Simple.
She is in charge of check the drawings.
She is in charge of checking the drawings.
Depois de of o verbo leva -ing.
quick: I ___ the focal point for the client. (be)

celebrate.en: Well done. You can now open a kick-off meeting and present your whole team in English.
celebrate.pt: Muito bem. Agora você abre uma reunião de kick-off e apresenta o time inteiro em inglês.

title: Who does what: the design disciplines
grammar: Perguntas no Present Simple (Who / What / Which + do / does)
objective: Nesta aula você vai aprender a fazer perguntas em inglês, que é o que mais trava numa reunião. A estrutura é sempre a mesma: palavra de pergunta + do/does + sujeito + verbo na forma base. 'Who does the piping design?', 'What does the civil team do?', 'Which discipline checks this drawing?'. O erro mais comum é deixar o -s no verbo depois de does.
intro: In a project there are five disciplines: mechanical, electrical, civil, piping and instrumentation. Each one produces different drawings, and everybody needs to know who does what.

To find out, you ask questions. Who does the piping design? What does the civil team produce? Which discipline approves this document? In English the question always follows the same order, and today we practise it.
vocab: The mechanical discipline designs the equipment.
Who works in the electrical discipline?
The civil team produces the foundation drawings.
Which engineer does the piping design?
What does the instrumentation team need from us?
practice: The ______ team produces the foundation drawings.
What does the ______ team need from us?
The ______ team draws the cable routing.
The ______ engineer checks the pipe supports.

audio.title: Questions in the kick-off meeting
audio.text: The client has some questions for us. Who does the piping design? Marcelo does the piping design, with two designers. What does the civil team produce? The civil team produces the foundation drawings and the general layout. Which discipline approves the electrical documents? Ana approves them, and then the client approves them too. How long does one revision take? A revision takes about five working days. Who do we contact for instrumentation? You contact Paulo. He is the focal point. Do you have any other questions? Please ask now, because after the meeting we start the detail design.

readAloud: Who does the piping design?
What does the civil team produce?
Which discipline approves this document?
How long does one revision take?
Do you have any other questions?
fill: What ___ the client need from us? (do)
___ Marcelo work in the piping discipline? (do)
qa: Who does the piping design?
Marcelo does the piping design.
What does the civil team produce?
The civil team produces the foundation drawings.
Which discipline approves the electrical documents?
Ana approves them, and then the client approves them too.
How long does one revision take?
It takes about five working days.
Who do we contact for instrumentation?
You contact Paulo. He is the focal point.
sentences: Who does the piping design?
What does the civil team produce?
Which discipline approves this document?
How long does one revision take?
Who do we contact for instrumentation?
Do you have any other questions?
Does Marcelo work in the piping discipline?
What do you need from us?
grammarPoint:
A ordem da pergunta é sempre a mesma:
Palavra de pergunta + do/does + sujeito + verbo (forma base)
What does the civil team produce?
How long does a revision take?

does → he, she, it, o nome de uma pessoa, uma equipe
do → I, you, we, they

Regra de ouro: se você usou does, o verbo depois não leva -s. O -s já foi para o does.
deepDive:
A exceção importante: quando a palavra de pergunta é o próprio sujeito, não entra do/does.
Who does the piping design? — aqui who é o sujeito e does é o verbo principal (fazer).
Which discipline approves this document? — which discipline é o sujeito, então o verbo leva -s direto.
Compare: Who do we contact? — aqui o sujeito é we, então entra o do.

As palavras de pergunta: Who (quem) · What (o que) · Which (qual, entre opções) · Where (onde) · When (quando) · Why (por quê) · How (como) · How long (quanto tempo) · How many (quantos).

Respostas curtas: Does Marcelo work here? — Yes, he does. / No, he doesn't.
examples: Who does the piping design?
Quem faz o projeto de tubulação?
What does the civil team produce?
O que a equipe civil produz?
Which discipline approves this document?
Qual disciplina aprova este documento?
How long does one revision take?
Quanto tempo leva uma revisão?
Who do we contact for instrumentation?
Quem procuramos para instrumentação?
Do you have any other questions?
Vocês têm outras perguntas?
Does Marcelo work in the piping discipline?
O Marcelo trabalha na disciplina de tubulação?
Where do the drawings go after approval?
Para onde vão os desenhos depois da aprovação?
mistakes: What does the civil team produces?
What does the civil team produce?
Depois de does o verbo fica na forma base.
Who do the piping design?
Who does the piping design?
Aqui who é o sujeito singular, então é does.
How long takes a revision?
How long does a revision take?
Falta o does na pergunta.
You have any other questions?
Do you have any other questions?
A pergunta começa com Do.
Which discipline does approve this?
Which discipline approves this?
Quando a pergunta é o sujeito, não entra does.

celebrate.en: Great. You can now ask a client or a colleague anything about the disciplines — and understand the answer.
celebrate.pt: Ótimo. Agora você pergunta ao cliente ou ao colega qualquer coisa sobre as disciplinas — e entende a resposta.

title: This is the scope of the project
grammar: there is / there are + quantificadores (some / any / a lot of)
objective: Nesta aula você vai apresentar o escopo do projeto: o que existe e quanto existe. A estrutura é 'there is' para singular e 'there are' para plural, com 'some' nas frases afirmativas e 'any' nas negativas e perguntas. É a forma mais rápida de dizer, em inglês, tudo o que faz parte do fornecimento.
intro: After the team, we present the scope. What is in this project? There are five disciplines. There is a mechanical package and there is an electrical package. There are also two civil works contracts.
There is and there are is the structure that lists things. It is short, it is clear, and the client can follow it without any effort. Today we build it, with some and any.
vocab: There is a lot of work in the mechanical scope.
There is some equipment from a foreign supplier.
There are two erection contracts in this project.
Are there any civil works in our scope?
There is no supply of spare parts in this contract.
There are five packages in the project.
practice: There is a lot of work in the mechanical ______.
There is some ______ from a foreign supplier.
There are two ______ contracts in this project.
Are there any ______ in our scope?
There is no ______ of spare parts in this contract.
There are five ______ in the project.
There are three ______ on this site.

audio.title: Presenting the scope
audio.text: Now let me present the scope of the project. There are five disciplines: mechanical, electrical, civil, piping and instrumentation. There is a lot of equipment in the mechanical package. Some of it comes from Brazil and some of it comes from Europe. There are two erection contracts, one mechanical and one electro mechanical. There is also a civil works contract for the foundations. Are there any spare parts in the scope? Yes, there are some spare parts for the first year. Is there any software in the scope? No, there isn't. The software is not part of our supply.

readAloud: There are five disciplines in the project.
There is a lot of equipment in the mechanical package.
There are some spare parts for the first year.
Is there any software in the scope?
No, there isn't.
fill: ___ five disciplines in the project. (there be)
___ a lot of equipment in this package. (there be)
Are there ___ civil works in our scope? (any/some)
Yes, there are ___ spare parts for the first year. (any/some)
Is ___ any software in the scope? (there be)
No, there ___ . The software is excluded. (be not)
There ___ any supply of spare parts after year one. (be not)
qa: How many disciplines are there in the project?
There are five disciplines.
Is there a lot of equipment in the mechanical package?
Yes, there is a lot of equipment.
Are there any civil works in your scope?
Yes, there is one civil works contract for the foundations.
Is there any software in the scope?
No, there isn't. The software is not part of our supply.
Are there any spare parts?
Yes, there are some spare parts for the first year.
sentences: There are five disciplines in the project.
There is a lot of equipment in the mechanical package.
There are two erection contracts.
Are there any civil works in our scope?
There are some spare parts for the first year.
Is there any software in the scope?
No, there isn't.
There is no supply of spare parts after the first year.
grammarPoint:
there is → uma coisa (singular) ou algo incontável: There is a civil contract. · There is a lot of equipment.
there are → várias coisas (plural): There are five disciplines.

Negativa: There isn't any software. · There aren't any spare parts.
Pergunta: Is there any software? · Are there any spare parts?

some × any: some nas afirmativas · any nas negativas e perguntas.
deepDive:
Substantivos incontáveis pedem sempre there is: equipment, work, information, software, steel, water, documentation. Nunca ponha -s neles.
There is a lot of equipment. (nunca equipments)

Quanto?
• incontável: a lot of / much (em perguntas e negativas) — How much work is there?
• contável: a lot of / many — How many packages are there?
• pouco: a little (incontável) / a few (contável)

Duas formas de negar, com o mesmo sentido:
There isn't any software in the scope.
There is no software in the scope. (mais forte, típica de contrato)

Some em pergunta é oferta: Would you like some coffee? — aqui o some é natural, porque você está oferecendo, não perguntando.
examples: There are five disciplines in the project.
Há cinco disciplinas no projeto.
There is a lot of equipment in this package.
Há muitos equipamentos neste pacote.
There are two erection contracts.
Há dois contratos de montagem.
Is there any software in the scope?
Há algum software no escopo?
No, there isn't any software.
Não, não há software nenhum.
There are some spare parts for the first year.
Há algumas peças sobressalentes para o primeiro ano.
How many packages are there?
Quantos pacotes há?
There is no supply of spare parts after year one.
Não há fornecimento de sobressalentes depois do primeiro ano.
mistakes: There is five disciplines.
There are five disciplines.
Plural pede there are.
There are a lot of equipments.
There is a lot of equipment.
equipment é incontável: sem -s e com there is.
Is there some software in the scope?
Is there any software in the scope?
Em pergunta use any.
There isn't no software.
There isn't any software.
Não use duas negações.
Have five disciplines in the project.
There are five disciplines in the project.
Para dizer que existe, use there is / there are.
quick: Is there ___ software in the scope?

celebrate.en: Very good. You can now present the whole scope of a project in clear, simple English.
celebrate.pt: Muito bom. Agora você apresenta o escopo inteiro do projeto num inglês claro e simples.

title: What is not included: the exclusion list
grammar: Negativas — doesn't include / isn't part of / there is no
objective: Nesta aula você vai apresentar a lista de exclusões, que é sempre a parte mais delicada da reunião. Você vai treinar as três formas de dizer que algo está fora: 'The scope doesn't include the software', 'The software isn't part of our supply', 'There is no supply of spare parts'. Em inglês, uma negativa clara evita uma discussão cara depois.
intro: Every proposal has two lists: what is included and what is not. The second list is short, but it is the one that saves the project. If it is not clear now, it becomes a discussion in six months.
The scope does not include the software. The civil works are not part of our supply. There is no supply of spare parts after the first year. Three structures, one message. Today you learn all three.
vocab: Please look at the exclusion list on page four.
The scope does not include the software.
The civil works are not part of our supply.
The foundations are the responsibility of the client.
There is no supply of spare parts after the first year.
The cables are a free issue from the client.
practice: Please look at the ______ on page four.
The scope does not ______ the software.
The civil works are not ______ our supply.
The foundations are the ______ of the client.
There is no supply of ______ after the first year.
The cables are a ______ from the client.
This does not ______ the erection work.

audio.title: Going through the exclusion list
audio.text: Now, please open page four. This is the exclusion list, and I want to go through it line by line. First, the scope does not include the software. The software is the responsibility of the client. Second, the civil works are not part of our supply. We supply the drawings, but we do not supply the concrete. Third, there is no supply of spare parts after the first year. Fourth, the cables are a free issue from the client. We do not buy them. I know this list is not the favourite part of the meeting, but it is very important. Do you have any questions about it?

readAloud: The scope does not include the software.
The civil works are not part of our supply.
There is no supply of spare parts after the first year.
We do not buy the cables.
The foundations are the responsibility of the client.
fill: The scope ___ include the software. (do not)
The civil works ___ part of our supply. (be not)
There ___ supply of spare parts after year one. (be no)
This item ___ in the contract. (be not included)
The client ___ pay for the erection. (do not)
There ___ any software in this package. (be not)
qa: Does the scope include the software?
No, it doesn't. The software is the responsibility of the client.
Are the civil works part of your supply?
No, they are not part of our supply.
Do you supply spare parts?
Yes, for the first year. After that, there is no supply of spare parts.
Who buys the cables?
The client buys them. They are a free issue.
Is the erection included?
No, it isn't. It is not part of this contract.
sentences: The scope does not include the software.
The civil works are not part of our supply.
There is no supply of spare parts after the first year.
We do not buy the cables.
The foundations are the responsibility of the client.
This item is not included in the contract.
Please look at the exclusion list on page four.
Do you have any questions about it?
grammarPoint:
Três formas de dizer que algo está fora:

1. don't / doesn't + verbo — The scope doesn't include the software.
2. am / is / are + not — The civil works are not part of our supply.
3. there is no / there isn't any — There is no supply of spare parts.

Regra que quase todo mundo erra: depois de doesn't o verbo fica na forma base, sem -s.
✗ doesn't includes → ✓ doesn't include
deepDive:
Quando usar cada uma:
• doesn't include — a mais direta, boa para falar do escopo em geral
• is not part of — mais formal, boa quando o cliente insiste
• there is no — a mais forte, típica de contrato e de anexo

Formas curtas (fala) × formas longas (documento):
fala: doesn't, isn't, aren't, don't
documento: does not, is not, are not, do not

Uma alternativa muito usada em especificação: a passiva.
This item is not included in the contract.
The software is excluded from our scope.

Como suavizar sem perder a clareza: comece com I'm afraid… ou Unfortunately… e depois vá direto ao ponto: I'm afraid the scope doesn't include the software.
examples: The scope does not include the software.
O escopo não inclui o software.
The civil works are not part of our supply.
A obra civil não faz parte do nosso fornecimento.
There is no supply of spare parts after year one.
Não há fornecimento de sobressalentes depois do primeiro ano.
We do not buy the cables.
Nós não compramos os cabos.
This item is not included in the contract.
Este item não está incluído no contrato.
The software is excluded from our scope.
O software está excluído do nosso escopo.
The foundations are the responsibility of the client.
As fundações são responsabilidade do cliente.
I'm afraid the erection isn't part of this contract.
Infelizmente a montagem não faz parte deste contrato.
mistakes: The scope doesn't includes the software.
The scope doesn't include the software.
Depois de doesn't o verbo fica sem -s.
The civil works is not part of our supply.
The civil works are not part of our supply.
works é plural: pede are.
There is no any spare parts.
There are no spare parts.
Não use no e any juntos.
We not buy the cables.
We do not buy the cables.
A negativa do verbo precisa de do not.
This item not is included.
This item is not included.
A ordem é verbo be + not.
quick: The scope ___ include the software. (do not)
The civil works ___ part of our supply. (be not)
There ___ supply of spare parts. (be no)
This item ___ in the contract. (be not included)

celebrate.en: Excellent. The exclusion list is the hardest slide in any kick-off — and now you can present it clearly and calmly.
celebrate.pt: Excelente. A lista de exclusões é o slide mais difícil de qualquer kick-off — e agora você o apresenta com clareza e calma.

title: The client asked for a change
grammar: Past Simple — verbos regulares e irregulares
objective: Nesta aula você vai contar o que aconteceu: o cliente pediu uma mudança, nós enviamos a proposta, ele aprovou o aditivo. Você vai treinar os verbos regulares (-ed) e a lista dos irregulares que mais aparecem em reunião de projeto (send/sent, make/made, take/took, come/came). No passado, o verbo não muda com he/she/it — isso é uma boa notícia.
intro: Last month the client asked for a change in the layout. We checked the impact, we prepared a proposal and we sent it on Friday. He received it, he made two comments and he approved the amendment on the fifteenth.
That is the Past Simple, and it is the tense of every meeting where you explain what happened. Regular verbs take -ed. Irregular verbs have their own form, and you simply have to know them.
vocab: The client asked for a change in the layout.
He approved the amendment on the fifteenth.
We checked the impact on the schedule.
We sent the proposal on Friday.
The drawing went to revision B last week.
practice: The client asked for a ______ in the layout.
He approved the ______ on the fifteenth.
We checked the ______ on the schedule.
The drawing went to ______ B last week.
This ______ increased the cost by ten per cent.

audio.title: What happened last month
audio.text: Let me explain what happened last month. On the second of April, the client asked for a change in the layout. We checked the impact on the schedule and on the cost. It was not a small change. On the fifth, we prepared a technical note and we sent it to the client. He received it the same day. He made two comments and he asked for one more meeting. We had the meeting on the tenth. After the meeting, we issued the commercial proposal, and the client approved the amendment on the fifteenth. The drawing went to revision B, and the detail team started the new design on the sixteenth.

readAloud: The client asked for a change in the layout.
We checked the impact on the schedule.
We sent the proposal on Friday.
He made two comments.
He approved the amendment on the fifteenth.
fill: The client ___ for a change in the layout. (ask)
We ___ the impact on the schedule. (check)
He ___ the amendment on the fifteenth. (approve)
We ___ the meeting on the tenth. (have)
qa: What did the client ask for?
He asked for a change in the layout.
What did you do?
We checked the impact and we sent a proposal.
When did you send the proposal?
We sent it on Friday.
Did he approve it?
Yes, he approved the amendment on the fifteenth.
How long did the approval take?
It took ten days.
sentences: The client asked for a change in the layout.
We checked the impact on the schedule.
We sent the proposal on Friday.
He made two comments.
He approved the amendment on the fifteenth.
The approval took ten days.
The drawing went to revision B.
We had the meeting on the tenth.
grammarPoint:
Past Simple = o que aconteceu e já terminou.

Regulares: verbo + -ed — ask → asked · check → checked · approve → approved · issue → issued

Irregulares (têm forma própria): send → sent · make → made · take → took · go → went · have → had · come → came · get → got · give → gave

Boa notícia: no passado o verbo é igual para todas as pessoas. I sent · he sent · they sent.
deepDive:
Negativa e pergunta usam did — e aí o verbo volta à forma base:
He did not send the proposal. (não: did not sent)
Did you send the proposal? (não: Did you sent)
O did já carrega o passado sozinho.

Respostas curtas: Did he approve it? — Yes, he did. / No, he didn't.

Marcadores de tempo que pedem Past Simple: yesterday, last week / month / year, two days ago, in April, on the fifteenth, when.

Verbos irregulares que aparecem em toda reunião de projeto:
send → sent · make → made · take → took · go → went · have → had · come → came · get → got · give → gave · begin → began · build → built · hold → held · meet → met · pay → paid · run → ran · write → wrote
examples: The client asked for a change.
O cliente pediu uma mudança.
We checked the impact on the schedule.
Nós verificamos o impacto no cronograma.
We sent the proposal on Friday.
Enviamos a proposta na sexta-feira.
He made two comments.
Ele fez dois comentários.
The approval took ten days.
A aprovação levou dez dias.
He didn't approve the first revision.
Ele não aprovou a primeira revisão.
Did you send the technical note?
Você enviou a nota técnica?
We had the meeting on the tenth.
Tivemos a reunião no dia dez.
mistakes: He didn't sent the proposal.
He didn't send the proposal.
Depois de didn't o verbo volta à forma base.
Did you sent the technical note?
Did you send the technical note?
Com did o verbo fica na forma base.
The approval taked ten days.
The approval took ten days.
take é irregular: took.
He approve the amendment yesterday.
He approved the amendment yesterday.
Com yesterday o verbo vai para o passado.
We was in the meeting.
We were in the meeting.
Com we o passado de be é were.

celebrate.en: Well done. You can now tell the story of a change request from beginning to end.
celebrate.pt: Muito bem. Agora você conta a história de uma solicitação de mudança do início ao fim.
